conditions.description: fetch accepts a caller-controlled URI and sends the request without scheme or host allowlisting.
conditions.rationale: The method can be directed toward internal or otherwise unintended network destinations.

conditions.description: The unsafe client follows redirects unconditionally.
conditions.rationale: Redirects can move an initially acceptable destination to an unintended host and broaden SSRF reach.

conditions.description: The unsafe request has no explicit connect or per-request timeout.
conditions.rationale: A slow or nonresponsive peer can hold resources for an unbounded interval relative to the application contract.

conditions.description: The unsafe fetch buffers the entire response body with no application-level size ceiling.
conditions.rationale: An attacker-controlled or misbehaving endpoint can force excessive memory consumption.

conditions.description: fetchApproved requires HTTPS and an exact api.example.com host before sending a request.
conditions.rationale: This explicit destination allowlist is a negative control and should not be reported as unrestricted SSRF.

conditions.description: fetchApproved disables redirects and applies explicit connect/request timeouts.
conditions.rationale: The bounded control should not be promoted to redirect or timeout findings.

conditions.description: Whether production egress firewall policy blocks metadata services or private networks is not established by this source.
conditions.rationale: Network policy is an external deployment property.

conditions.description: Whether production DNS resolution, proxying, or service-mesh policy mitigates rebinding or internal routing is not established.
conditions.rationale: Those controls require observed deployment evidence.

conditions.description: fetch must not be cleared as restricted to approved outbound destinations.
conditions.rationale: The method sends directly to arbitrary caller-provided URIs.

conditions.description: fetch must not be cleared as bounded against slow or oversized responses.
conditions.rationale: It lacks explicit timeout and body-size controls.
